about: Forty-four synthetic domain skeletons. Every condition has an explicit business_semantics decision fixing its use and target before sampling. Concrete types, predicates, and parameters are completed by the versioned registry and gold compiler before natural-language rendering. Source analogies do not certify real-world compliance.

field_kinds.identity: a person the resource records (owner, creator, handler); maps to V1, or V4 when it is a list
field_kinds.role: a role or kind the requester is; maps to V2
field_kinds.group: a group or hierarchy node the requester belongs to; maps to V3
field_kinds.set: a collection the requester may be a member of, or a set the resource carries; maps to V4
field_kinds.code: a text or code field; maps to V5
field_kinds.count: a whole-number quantity; maps to V6 (and V7 when two are added)
field_kinds.money: a monetary amount; maps to V8, or V6 for a coarse threshold
field_kinds.network: the request's network or location; maps to V9
field_kinds.timestamp: a time, deadline, or expiry; maps to V10
field_kinds.ordered-level: a ranked label (classification, sensitivity, hazard, clearance); maps to V6 ordered comparison and to G4 dominance
field_kinds.status: a lifecycle stage; maps to V11 and to G5 state gates
field_kinds.flag: an optional field or boolean that may be present/set; maps to V12
field_kinds.tag: a label the resource carries; maps to V13
field_kinds.context-fact: a fact about the request environment (MFA, emergency, on-site); maps to V14

anchor_schema.resource_type: the entity the anchor action applies to; its fields, the principal's fields, and context are the reachable read paths
anchor_schema.principal_roles: which roles may perform the anchor action (a prohibition on this action must name all of them)
anchor_schema.base_constraints: constraints that can stand as the anchor's rule; each has id (G..), signature (the atom the rule already reads, excluded from conditions), reads (the concrete path), meaning
anchor_schema.condition_atoms: Each condition has id, reads, meaning, and business_semantics (kind, target, enabled, statement, rationale). The sampler selects only enabled entries with their authored form and target; it never randomly reinterprets their meaning.
anchor_schema.override_elements: conflicting exceptions (G3-style) that override a base; presence forces requires_adjudication; each names which base id(s) it overrides
